note.en: names with >=15% of revenue from explicitly-EM-classified regions in their 10-K geographic note (measured per-name; em_pct is a conservative lower bound — mixed aggregates never counted). Names without a parseable disclosure bucket as unevaluable.
note.zh: 10-K地区披露中明确属新兴市场的营收占比≥15%的名字（逐名实测；em_pct为保守下限——混合地区聚合不计入）。无可解析披露的名字归入无法评估桶。

note.en: US multinationals with >=40% foreign revenue (10-K geographic note, measured per-name) — overseas EPS shrinks in dollar terms as USD firms. PERCENT 0-100; unparseable names bucket as unevaluable.
note.zh: 海外营收占比≥40%的美国跨国企业（10-K地区披露，逐名实测）——美元走强时海外每股盈利以美元计缩水。百分比0-100；无法解析的名字归入无法评估桶。

note.en: leveraged names (top-third debt_to_assets) whose revenue is majority non-US (>=50%, 10-K geographic note) — dollar-debt service against non-dollar cash flows. Assumes US filers' debt is USD-denominated (stated assumption; no currency-of-debt field exists).
note.zh: 高杠杆（debt_to_assets前三分之一）且营收过半来自美国以外（≥50%，10-K地区披露）的名字——以非美元现金流偿付美元债务。假设美国披露人的债务以美元计价（明示假设；无债务币种字段）。

label.zh: 新兴市场/商品行业（代理）

note.en: PROXY (sector, not revenue): GICS sector membership stands in for EM-demand exposure — Materials & Energy are the dollar-priced-commodity sectors most EM/dollar-sensitive. Complements em_revenue_exposure (rev 2): sector coverage is ~full, so it also catches names whose 10-K discloses no parseable geography. A coarse sector stand-in, not a revenue measurement.
note.zh: 代理（行业而非营收）：以GICS行业归属代表新兴市场需求敞口——材料与能源是对新兴市场/美元最敏感的美元计价商品行业。与rev 2的em_revenue_exposure互补：行业覆盖近乎全库，故也覆盖10-K无可解析地区披露的名字。粗略的行业替代，非营收测度。

title.en: Vol-regime shift → systematic deleveraging → high-beta unwind
title.zh: 波动率状态转变 → 系统性去杠杆 → 高贝塔平仓

method.from: proxy: fred/VIXCLS vix>=25 (VIX-floor leg only; categorical vol-regime label not historized — honest partial, under-counts label-only activations below VIX 25)
method.to: untested: state-adapter node (src=regime_state) has no stored history and no documented series proxy — not reconstructable, not fabricated

vol_expansion->systematic_delever.regime_split_reason: a node could not be historized (see method)
vol_expansion->systematic_delever.untested_reason: upstream or downstream node not reconstructable from collected series

cohort_event_study.note: descriptive forward excess return of the terminal cohort proxy at terminal-node firings — NOT a forecast, NOT a signal (display-only).

note.en: PROXY (not true beta): the substrate has no market-beta field, so this uses annualized realized volatility (risk_sizing.vol_ann_pct) top-quintile as the deleveraging-exposure proxy — high-vol names are cut hardest pro-rata to risk.
note.zh: 代理（非真实贝塔）：个股数据无市场贝塔字段，故使用年化已实现波动率（risk_sizing.vol_ann_pct）前五分位作为去杠杆敞口代理——高波动名字按风险比例被最先削减。

note.en: crowded names with concentrated holders or a heavy short — the positioning to unwind FROM
note.zh: 持有人集中或空头沉重的拥挤名字——可平仓的仓位来源

note.en: names in the bottom quintile of 20-day average dollar volume (tech.dollar_vol_20d, a level-of-liquidity screen) — a deleveraging forces sales into a thinner book, so the least-liquid names take the largest impact-cost hit. A liquidity LEVEL, not a volume-spike detection (distinct from the killed abnormal-volume constructions). Names without the field bucket as unevaluable.
note.zh: 20日平均成交额（tech.dollar_vol_20d，流动性水平筛选）处于最低五分位的名字——去杠杆迫使卖单进入更薄的盘口，流动性最差的名字承受最大的冲击成本。这是流动性“水平”，而非成交量异动检测（区别于已弃用的异常成交量构造）。无该字段的名字归入无法评估桶。

caveats.en: Display-only context — never scored, never a call. A chain state is a WATCH item; it never gates, sizes, ranks, or escalates anything (masterplan §4).
caveats.zh: 仅供展示的上下文——从不计入评分，从不作为交易指令。链状态是观察项；不做任何门控、仓位、排名或升级。

caveats.en: Per-hop base rates come from the WEEKLY historical episode miner (W3) when its artifact is present: pooled + per-regime P(hop confirms | upstream fired) with n. A hop with n below the floor prints "untested" WITH its n — never a fabricated rate. Absent the artifact, base_rates is null. A propagating chain is not a forecast; a base rate is a printed conditional frequency, not a signal.
caveats.zh: 各跳基础发生率来自每周历史情景挖掘（W3）——存在其产物时：汇总＋分regime的P(跳确认|上游触发)并附n。样本量低于下限的跳打印“未检验”并附其n——绝不编造发生率。无该产物时base_rates为null。传导中的链并非预测；基础发生率是打印的条件频率，而非信号。

caveats.en: Per-name blast radius (`blast`) is a WATCH-grade membership screen with a field receipt, resolved over the per-ticker substrate — never a call and never a size. Counts always include the unevaluable (missing-field) bucket: a missing field is neither safe nor unsafe. Only ARMED chains resolve; dormant chains carry blast={}.
caveats.zh: 个股层面的传导范围（blast）是带字段凭证的观察级成员筛选，基于个股数据解析——绝非交易指令、绝非仓位。计数始终包含无法评估（字段缺失）的桶：字段缺失既不安全也不危险。仅已触发的链解析；休眠链的blast为空。
